sites.enforcement_snippet:
if invoice.status in ("paid", "void"):
    raise InvoiceClosedError(f"Invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")

domain_notes: pay_invoice rejects payment when the invoice is already 'paid' or 'void', guarded by a single membership check before it decrements balance. Both existing tests begin with an 'open' invoice; neither pays a finalized invoice, so the rejection path is never exercised.
rationale: Selected pay_invoice because its status membership check is the sole enforcement and no test pays a finalized invoice.
